messages:
lina: Noticed mismatch in /v1/embeds request schema: examples show `input: ["a","b"]` but the schema lists `input: string`. Causing confusion in SDK snippets and a support ticket.

jack: Oof. Which example file? I can search and patch.

lina: The cURL and node snippets under https://staging-docs.redwood.com/reference/embeddings. The example earlier in the page shows array but the OpenAPI schema currently defines single string.

harper: We intentionally supported both server-side (single string) and batch (array) but docs should clarify and show both shapes. Suggest: "input: string | string[]" with two short examples labeled "single" and "batch".

jack: Agreed. I'll add explicit examples and update the Python/JS SDK snippets to use `client.embeddings.create({ input: ["a","b"] })` for batch. Also add a migration note for older clients that accepted arrays as repeated calls.

lina: Please also add a one-line note about the response shape: array of embeddings in same order as inputs. We've had support tickets where users expected a single vector for arrays.

docs-bot: @jack opened PR #4178: "docs: clarify embeddings input shape (single vs batch) and update SDK snippets" — preview: https://deploy-preview.redwood.com/4178/reference/embeddings

jack: PTAL @lina @harper. I added OpenAPI example for both shapes, updated code snippets, and included the response-order note.

harper: LGTM. Tiny nit: use `inputs` vs `input`? What's the canonical param we use in SDKs?

lina: SDK uses `input` currently. Keep docs consistent with API but add a short line: "SDKs accept `input` as string or array."

jack: Merged PR #4178. Deploy succeeded.

docs-bot: PR #4178 merged by jack at 3141592690. Docs deploy: docs-deploy/794. Live: https://docs.redwood.com/reference/embeddings

lina: Thanks — closing thread.
